title: Audit Samantha heartbeat and define the shared liveness+signal contract
description:
```wg-contract
schema = 1
mode = "core"
objective = "Audit Samantha heartbeat and define the shared liveness+signal contract"
non_goals = ["implementing the schema or endpoint", "changing legacy POST /heartbeat or /heartbeat/check", "adding domain scanners"]
touch = ["paia-agents/docs/agent-heartbeat-contract.md"]
acceptance = ["AgentHeartbeat schema fields enumerated", "migration approach for Samantha GET endpoint decided", "zero-cloud-call signal-provider contract defined", "per-agent domain_signals keys proposed", "sub-50ms no-cloud guarantee recorded"]
max_files = 2
max_loc = 120
```
Read-only audit that produces the contract the rest of the graph consumes. Examine samantha/src/samantha/api/routes.py (the three legacy /api/agent/heartbeat* endpoints returning HeartbeatDecision), samantha/src/samantha/heartbeat.py, paia-agent-runtime/src/paia_agent_runtime (router/app patterns), and paia-contracts/src/paia_contracts (where cross-agent schemas live, e.g. agent_state.py, identity.py). Decide and document in paia-agents/docs/agent-heartbeat-contract.md: (1) the canonical AgentHeartbeat Pydantic schema fields; (2) that GET /api/agent/heartbeat is repurposed to AgentHeartbeat while the legacy POST /heartbeat and GET /heartbeat/check proactive-outreach stubs stay untouched; (3) the signal-provider contract (sync, local-only, no cloud calls, sub-50ms); (4) proposed domain_signals keys per agent from each agent's local modules; (5) the explicit no-outbound-network guarantee that ties this to the North Star. No code changes beyond the doc.
acceptance: Decision doc paia-agents/docs/agent-heartbeat-contract.md exists and names the canonical schema AgentHeartbeat with fields: schema_version(int), agent_id(str), agent_role(str), status(literal ok|degraded|down), timestamp(UTC datetime, server clock only), uptime_seconds(float), version(str), domain_signals(dict[str, object]), notes(str|None).

Doc states the migration approach for Samantha: repurpose GET /api/agent/heartbeat to the new AgentHeartbeat schema; preserve the existing legacy POST /api/agent/heartbeat and GET /api/agent/heartbeat/check proactive-outreach stubs unchanged.
Doc defines the signal-provider contract: a sync (non-async), zero-cloud-call callable returning domain_signals from in-process/local state only.

Doc lists the proposed per-agent domain_signals keys for derek, ingrid, caroline, samantha drawn from each agent's local modules (e.g. derek health_monitor, ingrid crm_client/publishing_blog, caroline bd state, samantha scanner/workboard cache).
Doc records an explicit guarantee that the heartbeat path makes no outbound network/cloud calls and returns in <50ms.
escalation_reason: This locks the shared contract that the runtime factory plus all four agents build on; getting it wrong forces four-way rework. Requires reading Samantha's legacy proactive-outreach semantics (HeartbeatDecision, three legacy endpoints), deciding repurpose-vs-new-path, and designing a schema that is genuinely cheap and cloud-free while still carrying real per-agent domain signal. That is design judgment cheaper tiers underperform on.

title: Add canonical AgentHeartbeat schema to paia-contracts
description:
```wg-contract
schema = 1
mode = "core"
objective = "Add canonical AgentHeartbeat schema to paia-contracts"
non_goals = ["FastAPI router or endpoint", "per-agent domain scanners", "touching any agent repo"]
touch = ["paia-contracts/src/paia_contracts/heartbeat.py", "paia-contracts/src/paia_contracts/__init__.py", "paia-contracts/docs/agent-heartbeat-schema.md"]
acceptance = ["AgentHeartbeat pydantic model with strict fields", "re-exported from package __init__", "schema doc written", "mypy strict + ruff clean"]
max_files = 4
max_loc = 150
```
Implement the shared contract decided in the audit. Create paia-contracts/src/paia_contracts/heartbeat.py with AgentHeartbeat(BaseModel) matching the audit doc field-for-field (schema_version default 1, agent_id, agent_role, status Literal['ok','degraded','down'], timezone-aware UTC timestamp, uptime_seconds, version, domain_signals dict[str, object], optional notes). Re-export from paia_contracts/__init__.py. Write paia-contracts/docs/agent-heartbeat-schema.md documenting each field plus the invariant: the heartbeat MUST be populated from local/in-process state only with no outbound network calls. Follow existing paia_contracts module style (strict mypy, pydantic v2).
verify: cd paia-contracts && uv run python -c "import paia_contracts; from paia_contracts import AgentHeartbeat; m=AgentHeartbeat(agent_id='x',agent_role='y',status='ok',timestamp='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00',uptime_seconds=1.0,version='0.1.0',domain_signals={}); assert m.schema_version==1" && uv run mypy src/paia_contracts/heartbeat.py && uv run ruff check src/paia_contracts/heartbeat.py
acceptance: paia_contracts.heartbeat defines AgentHeartbeat(BaseModel) with the fields enumerated in the audit doc and strict typing (status is a Literal, timestamp is timezone-aware UTC datetime, domain_signals is dict[str, object]).
AgentHeartbeat is re-exported from paia_contracts/__init__.py.
A JSON schema doc is generated/documented in paia-contracts/docs/agent-heartbeat-schema.md with field table and the no-cloud-call invariant.
uv run mypy (strict) and uv run ruff check are clean on the new file.

title: Add shared heartbeat router factory to paia-agent-runtime
description:
```wg-contract
schema = 1
mode = "core"
objective = "Add shared heartbeat router factory to paia-agent-runtime"
non_goals = ["per-agent domain scanner logic", "wiring any specific agent", "changing legacy samantha endpoints"]
touch = ["paia-agent-runtime/src/paia_agent_runtime/heartbeat.py", "paia-agent-runtime/src/paia_agent_runtime/__init__.py", "paia-agent-runtime/tests/test_heartbeat_factory.py"]
acceptance = ["mount_heartbeat_router factory builds GET /api/agent/heartbeat returning AgentHeartbeat", "signal_provider is sync and is the only domain data source", "TestClient asserts schema conformance + 200", "mypy strict + ruff clean"]
max_files = 4
max_loc = 250
```
Build the shared HTTP machinery in paia-agent-runtime so all four agents consume one implementation (no copy-paste). Create paia_agent_runtime/heartbeat.py with mount_heartbeat_router(agent_id: str, agent_role: str, version: str, signal_provider: Callable[[], dict[str, object]]) -> APIRouter (prefix '/api/agent'). The GET /heartbeat handler records a process start time for uptime, reads the server clock for timestamp, calls signal_provider() for domain_signals, and returns AgentHeartbeat. Import AgentHeartbeat from paia_contracts. Add a contract test using starlette TestClient that mounts the router, hits GET /api/agent/heartbeat, and validates the response against AgentHeartbeat plus confirms signal_provider output flows through. Re-export mount_heartbeat_router from the package __init__. If the contract test fails against the schema, fix and retest (max 3).
verify: cd paia-agent-runtime && uv run pytest tests/test_heartbeat_factory.py -q && uv run mypy src/paia_agent_runtime/heartbeat.py && uv run ruff check src/paia_agent_runtime/heartbeat.py
acceptance: paia_agent_runtime.heartbeat exposes mount_heartbeat_router(agent_id, agent_role, version, signal_provider) returning a fastapi.APIRouter with prefix /api/agent.

signal_provider is a sync callable () -> dict[str, object]; the GET /heartbeat handler builds and returns an AgentHeartbeat using only the server clock, uptime, and signal_provider output — no httpx/cloud calls.
GET /heartbeat returns 200 and a body validating against AgentHeartbeat; OpenAPI response_model is AgentHeartbeat.
test_heartbeat_factory.py mounts the router on a FastAPI app via TestClient and asserts schema conformance, status_code 200, and that the signal_provider is the only data source (no outbound calls).
uv run mypy (strict) and uv run ruff check clean.

verify: NorthStarDrift v2 alignment check scoped to {audit-samantha-heartbeat, define-shared-heartbeat-schema, mount-runtime-heartbeat-factory}; outcome recorded in task log
acceptance: NorthStarDrift v2 alignment check scoped to {audit, schema, factory} returns aligned (or drifting-with-acceptable-plan); not lost.
Confirmed in writing: the AgentHeartbeat path satisfies the North Star (cheap liveness + domain signal) and carries an explicit no-outbound-cloud-call guarantee before four agents build on it.
Explicit go/no-go decision recorded in the task log for the parallel fan-out.

title: Wire Samantha to the shared heartbeat factory (canonical migration)
description:
```wg-contract
schema = 1
mode = "core"
objective = "Wire Samantha to the shared heartbeat factory (canonical migration)"
non_goals = ["removing legacy POST /heartbeat or /heartbeat/check", "adding cloud calls to the signal provider", "changing other agents"]
touch = ["paia-agents/samantha/src/samantha/api/routes.py", "paia-agents/samantha/src/samantha/heartbeat.py", "paia-agents/samantha/tests/test_heartbeat.py"]
acceptance = ["GET /api/agent/heartbeat returns AgentHeartbeat via shared factory", "domain_signals populated from local samantha state", "legacy POST /heartbeat and /heartbeat/check unchanged", "contract test green", "mypy strict + ruff clean"]
max_files = 4
max_loc = 200
```
Canonical wiring that proves the shared factory end-to-end. In samantha/src/samantha/heartbeat.py add a sync samantha_signal_provider() reading local/in-process state only (e.g. recent scanner/workboard cache counts, pending clarifications) and returning a domain_signals dict matching the audit doc's proposed samantha keys. In samantha/src/samantha/api/routes.py (or app.py) mount the shared mount_heartbeat_router('samantha', role, __version__, samantha_signal_provider). Leave the existing legacy POST /heartbeat and GET /heartbeat/check HeartbeatDecision stubs exactly as-is. Add tests/test_heartbeat.py using TestClient against create_app(): assert GET /api/agent/heartbeat validates as AgentHeartbeat, agent_id=='samantha', domain_signals non-empty, latency <50ms, and assert the legacy POST /heartbeat and GET /heartbeat/check still return HeartbeatDecision. Fix and retest on contract drift (max 2).
verify: cd paia-agents/samantha && uv run pytest tests/test_heartbeat.py -q && uv run ruff check src && uv run mypy src
acceptance: Samantha app mounts the shared mount_heartbeat_router so GET /api/agent/heartbeat returns an AgentHeartbeat with agent_id='samantha' and a non-empty domain_signals populated by a local-only signal_provider (e.g. scanner/workboard cache state).
Legacy POST /api/agent/heartbeat and GET /api/agent/heartbeat/check proactive-outreach stubs remain unchanged and still return HeartbeatDecision.
test_heartbeat.py asserts GET /heartbeat validates against AgentHeartbeat, agent_id is correct, domain_signals is non-empty, and response time is <50ms with no outbound calls.
uv run mypy (strict) and uv run ruff check clean for samantha.

title: Cross-agent smoke test of all four heartbeat endpoints
description: End-to-end cross-agent verification. Add paia-agents/samantha/tests/heartbeat_smoke_test.py (samantha's env already dev-deps ingrid, caroline, derek, so it can import all four create_app callables). For each of samantha, derek, ingrid, caroline: build the FastAPI app, hit GET /api/agent/heartbeat with TestClient, assert 200, validate the body against paia_contracts.AgentHeartbeat, assert agent_id matches and domain_signals is non-empty. Add a no-outbound-call guard (e.g. monkeypatch httpx clients / assert no network socket) and a <50ms latency assertion, proving the North Star's 'cheap liveness without cloud calls'. If any agent fails schema conformance, agent_id, signal presence, or the no-cloud/latency guard, diagnose and fix in the offending agent, then retest — max 3 iterations. Prefer fixing the agent over weakening the test.
verify: cd paia-agents/samantha && uv run pytest tests/heartbeat_smoke_test.py -q
acceptance: heartbeat_smoke_test.py spins up all four apps via their create_app() + TestClient and asserts GET /api/agent/heartbeat on each returns 200 validating against AgentHeartbeat.
Asserts agent_id is samantha/derek/ingrid/caroline respectively and each domain_signals is non-empty.
Asserts every response completes in <50ms and makes no outbound network call (assert via mocked/patched httpx or a no-network guard).
Smoke test is green; any failures diagnosed and fixed within max_iterations, then retest.

Log any residual drift as an explicit follow-up rather than absorbing it. Record the final alignment verdict in the task log.
verify: NorthStarDrift v2 alignment check scoped to the full heartbeat graph; outcome recorded in task log
acceptance: NorthStarDrift v2 alignment check scoped to the full graph returns aligned.
